title: Single Incision Versus Conventional Laparoscopic Appendectomy
brief_summary: This is a randomized prospective study comparing single incision versus conventional laparoscopic appendectomy for management of acute appendicitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* acute appendicitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* perforation with peritonitis
* lower abdominal scar
* contraindications to laparoscopy
